description: Dept. of Local Government - Eastern Province - By-laws of  Navithanweli, Padiyathalawa, Thirukkovil and Uhana P/S
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the approval and publication of new by-laws for the Navithanveli Pradeshiya Sabha. The by-laws establish regulatory frameworks for controlling advertisements, hotels, bakeries, businesses, and salons within the local authority area. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it involves the creation of subsidiary legislation and regulatory requirements under the authority of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act. While a government official (the Governor) is named, the core content is about regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes, making Type 5 the appropriate classification over the government-related types.
